page_title: FUL 2-2 BOU | Fulham v Bournemouth 29/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Robert Jones has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' A player from Fulham commits a rough challenge. Robert Jones blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90+6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+6' One of the Bournemouth players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Fulham are awarded the free kick.
90+2' Substitution. Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) has come on for Alex Iwobi.
90+2' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Joshua King (Fulham) replaces Sasa Lukic.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' 2 - 2 GOAL - 2:2! Antoine Semenyo found Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Bernd Leno off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
88' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) commits a foul during an attacking move.
86' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
83' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Robert Jones didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
82' Here comes a substitution. Evanilson is given a rest as he is replaced by Ben Winterburn (Bournemouth).
82' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. James Hill is replaced by Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth).
82' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card!
81' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
81' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kepa Arrizabalaga.
78' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Harry Wilson will be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
77' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Philip Billing walks off the pitch to be replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
72' 2 - 1 Harry Wilson (Fulham) reacts well to a deflected cross from Antonee Robinson and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the right of the goal. 2:1.
72' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:7.
72' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

71' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
68' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Andreas Pereira and he is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Raul Jimenez as he is replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
68' Evanilson (Bournemouth) picks up a long through ball, but Bernd Leno deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

67' What a save from Kepa Arrizabalaga! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
66' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaps to collect the ball.
66' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
64' Here is a change. David Brooks is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
60' David Brooks (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Kepa Arrizabalaga gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
56' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
54' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

51' 1 - 1 James Hill sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Evanilson (Bournemouth) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.
50' David Brooks (Bournemouth) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno easily deals with the threat.
49' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Brooks (Bournemouth).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
45+1' The ref seems satisfied following his VAR review and the yellow card for Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) stands. Play continues.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

43' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth), but referee Robert Jones must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
43' It's a yellow card for Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
40' 1 - 0 Gooal! Andreas Pereira takes over corner duties. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 1:0.
40' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
39' Evanilson (Bournemouth) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
39' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
36' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
32' The James Hill (Bournemouth) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Robert Jones rules it out for a foul.
32' A player from Bournemouth commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
32' The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.

31' What a wasted opportunity by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Bernd Leno makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
31' Fulham concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
28' The resulting corner, taken by Philip Billing (Bournemouth), comes to nothing.
26' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) takes the corner with a short pass.
26' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

26' David Brooks (Bournemouth) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Bournemouth force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
24' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
23' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
20' Evanilson (Bournemouth) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Bernd Leno.
19' David Brooks (Bournemouth) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
18' James Hill (Bournemouth) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' David Brooks (Bournemouth) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
15' Harry Wilson (Fulham) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.

11' That didn't go as planned! Joachim Andersen (Fulham) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Kepa Arrizabalaga, who easily kept it out.
10' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Bernd Leno stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
9' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
6' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
5' James Hill (Bournemouth) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
4' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Evanilson (Bournemouth) dribbles into the box, but Bernd Leno is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
2' Robert Jones interrupts the game. One of the players from Bournemouth won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Fulham will take the kick-off.
Robert Jones will referee today's match.
